rules: The company is always 'NavisLabs' (on screen: NAVISLABS). Never 'Navis', 'Navis AI' or 'Navis-AI' for the company.
The human-facing product is 'Navis Application' (on screen: NAVIS APPLICATION).
The developer / agent product is 'Navis Developer' (on screen: NAVIS DEVELOPER).

Bare 'Navis' is allowed only as spoken product shorthand inside an act whose product title is already on screen (L12 -> Navis Developer, L18 -> Navis Application), and inside real product UI text captured in recordings (the app's masthead 'Today · Navis').
'Navis-AI' is only a code-repository name in evidence fields; it never appears in the film.

shared_thesis.statement: Navis Application and Navis Developer are two ways into the same organizational context, built by NavisLabs.
shared_thesis.not_on_screen: TWO WAYS IN — creative intent only; not in the approved master copy (pending approval)
evidence: F18 (staging): the Developer API delegates to the same handlers the web app uses — one implementation of each organizational read
not_true_yet: An agent's coding work appearing inside Navis AI

story: Capability alone does not give an agent the context of a company.
Company knowledge lives across work; people understand it; agents need the right part of it.
NavisLabs builds the shared layer between the organization's work, its people and its agents.
Two ways in: Navis Developer for agents and developers; Navis Application for people.
Proven with real product footage only.
creative_direction.feel: premium Silicon Valley announcement; real technical proof; founder conviction
spine: AGENTS: it asks the company, with sources
AGENTS: each key sees only its own
principles: Belief first, proof second, consequence last.
One idea per scene; at most one line of film typography on screen at a time.
Real product footage only. Every product word on screen was produced by the product during recording.
Silence is a tool: three deliberate silences (after 'It doesn't know your company', before 'This is Navis', and the held breath before 'Reply sent').
No effect without a narrative reason (see motion_system.transition_language).
Kanu is a reference for discipline only; no script, sentence, claim or positioning is borrowed.

visual_language.rule: DARK = AGENTS / NAVIS DEVELOPER. LIGHT = PEOPLE / NAVIS APPLICATION. THE BLUE LINE = the NavisLabs layer between them.

voiceover.talent: the founder's own voice: calm, deep, confident, precise, slightly intense — a founder explaining something they believe; never an announcer or corporate narrator
workflow: Founder records the script naturally, line by line (L01–L21), 3 takes each, close-mic in a dry room, WAV 48 kHz 24-bit mono.
Adobe Podcast Enhance on the raw takes at moderate strength (~40–60%), A/B against the raw take; keep breaths.

ElevenLabs Voice Changer (speech-to-speech) using ONLY the founder's own voice model, to polish while preserving cadence, emotion, delivery and accent; never another person's voice, never an imitation.
If a line must be generated from text (voice clone), the clone must be the founder's own, with written consent on file.
Export each line to public/voiceover/Lxx.wav; place at its start; keep speech inside hard_latest_end.

voiceover.full_text: AI knows the world. It doesn’t know your company. What was decided. Who’s waiting. What’s still open. It lives in inboxes, calendars and people’s heads — so every new session starts with a re-brief. Models will change. Agents will change. What your company knows should persist. This is NavisLabs. For agents, Navis Developer keeps the work state. Close the session tonight. Tomorrow, a fresh one opens with the objective, the decisions it recorded, and what’s still open. You type one word. When the task depends on your company, the agent asks Navis — and gets the facts that bear on it. With sources. With how fresh they are. Every key sees only its own company — and only what it’s allowed to. For people, the same understanding becomes your morning. Who’s waiting on you. The reply, already drafted. You read it. You change a line. You approve it. Navis sends it — and only says sent when Gmail confirms. People and agents, working from one shared understanding of your company. Next: every outcome feeds back into what it knows. NavisLabs. Your company’s intelligence — for your people, and your agents.
